tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall strictly upload only the documents required under the tender conditions. No additional, irrelevant or unsolicited documents shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Legally registered firm/company with PAN, GST registration where applicable, and relevant EPF, ESI and labour registrations.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Legally registered firm/company with PAN, GST registration where applicable, and relevant EPF, ESI and labour registrations.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory O&M experience of at least one sewage treatment plant of 6.4 MLD capacity or above for not less than 12 months within the preceding five years as a prime contractor.Experience/work-done certification shall be issued by a competent Government department, ULB, PSU or other Government institution of rank not below the Executive Engineer.
Average annual turnover should be minimum Rs.3.52 crore in at least two financial years during 2021-22 to 2025-26. CA-certified turnover certificate with UDIN shall be submitted.
